tasks.task: Write product descriptions for one product or a batch

items.when: When new products arrive with no copy and you need the run from label to live page and feed
Before writing, to tie each page section to a real doubt buyers have
When there are reviews or support emails, to find the buying reasons in customers' own words
When the fact sheet is checked and you need titles, bullets, description and specs
When the first version is flat, to see the same facts in two or three structures and tones
When a product has a story and the page should pull the reader from line to line
When the copy is finished, to get a ship, fix or rewrite call with three fixes

tasks.task: Build a checked fact sheet from a label or supplier sheet

items.when: Before any product copy, to turn a label photo or spec sheet into checked facts with gaps marked
When maker and supplier notes exist, to find true facts about how it is made that rivals never state
When the sheet is built, to see which planned claims the evidence supports

tasks.task: Rewrite thin or look-alike descriptions so each is distinct

items.when: Before rewriting, to put each product's features in buying order and flag claims needing proof
When descriptions are thin, to add materials, uses and facts a shopper needs
When a batch of similar products each needs its own reason to choose it
When two products read the same, to try a different structure and tone for each
When the copy is all adjectives, to swap each for a specific fact
When a line is vague, to test it and get a true version a shopper can picture

tasks.task: Write titles for the page, search, feed and marketplace

items.when: When one product needs a page title, SEO title, feed title and marketplace title in limits
When you have the search terms that convert and need search-led feed titles
When the whole list needs tidy, consistent titles as a file to import
When the page also needs a meta description and social share tags that fit
After the batch, to catch titles over a platform limit and mixed naming or units

tasks.task: Write a collection page for buying searches

items.when: Before writing, to check which buying searches deserve a collection page
When you need the intro, a buying guide from real product differences and an FAQ
When the page needs its title, heading, address and copy set for one keyword
When the page heading and intro line need several angles to choose from
When the page is live, to check which products to feature and what to fix
Before writing, to confirm the products the page leads with are in stock at the stated price today

tasks.task: Write an Amazon listing set

items.when: Before writing, to read rival listings and reviews for their weak spots and your best points
When you have facts and keyword tiers and need a title, five bullets and a description
When you want a second, plainer version to compare before choosing
Before upload, to check every claim in the bullets against the label and the rules

tasks.task: Write an Etsy or other marketplace listing

items.when: When you need a title, bullets and description built for one marketplace's rules
When it is an Etsy listing, to score it and get a better title and tags

tasks.task: Write a food product page from the label

items.when: Before writing, to copy ingredients, allergens, weight and storage from the label exactly
When taste and story matter but every label fact must match
When the taste copy is generic and should say what eating it is really like
Before it ships, to check origin, free-from, allergen and health wording
When the page hints at a health benefit, to sort each claim by its evidence

tasks.task: Write gift box and bundle copy

items.when: When the bundle is not fixed yet, to plan it from products, margins and shipping costs
When the client wants a gift, bundle or pre-order offer and not a plain price cut
When it is a food gift box or hamper and each item's label facts must carry over
When the bundle saves money, to choose how to show the saving
Before launch, to check price-reduction and deadline claims are true

tasks.task: Write order, dispatch, delay and delivered emails

items.when: When the emails should answer what customers write in to ask, in the shop's voice
When late parcels drive tickets, to plan the update flow and tracking page
When the delay email sounds cold, to see the same facts in two or three tones
Before the emails go live, to get counts, cuts and a ship or fix score

tasks.task: Write a maker story and about page

items.when: When you have the true facts of how the maker started and need them shaped and cut
When the about page must sound like the maker and not a template
When the page opens flat, to compare five headlines with a subhead
When the story is about the founder and should be about what is special in the product
When the story is drafted, to fix lines that sound machine made

tasks.task: Turn shopper questions into a product FAQ and image captions

items.when: When you have customer questions, to see which ones the page does not answer
When the same questions keep coming, to answer them on the page and beside the photos
When the gallery should answer questions, to review each photo and plan what it must show
When the questions are store-wide and belong on one FAQ page
When answers are drafted, to make sure each rests on a fact you hold

tasks.task: Audit catalogue copy and list the fixes

items.when: Monthly or quarterly, to run the refresh in order across the catalogue
When you have the export, to find duplicates, supplier text, missing fields and mixed units
When the store is connected, to list pages that are empty, short or missing search fields
Each month, to catch new data faults such as clashing codes and hidden products

tasks.task: Check claims against the label and the proof

items.when: Before copy ships, to check origin, material, green, health, allergen and price claims
When the client has evidence on file, to see which claims go too far
When there is no proof file, to sort each claim as fine, needs proof or cut
When pages quote reviews, to keep approved quotes checked and linked to evidence

tasks.task: Plan search copy, keywords and markup for product pages

items.when: Before writing, to give each page one topic so pages do not compete
When one product targets one term and needs layout, copy, image names and markup
When the page needs product markup ready to paste for rich results

tasks.task: Make product pages easy for AI shopping tools to read

items.when: Before editing, to list the questions shoppers ask AI about products like these
When a page needs clear facts, a spec table and FAQs that AI tools can quote
When the store is live, to score what AI shopping tools can and cannot see

tasks.task: Review a product page and rank the fixes

items.when: When the client sends a live page, to get ranked changes to copy, proof, buttons and price
When the page order is wrong, to plan the sections from the buyers' doubts
When the copy loses readers, to mark each line for whether it pulls them on

tasks.task: Mine reviews for buyer words and proof

items.when: When you have reviews or a manual, to sort its own phrases for headlines and proof
When you want the reasons people bought, in their exact words, ranked
When you have the quotes, to decide which proof to show, from whom and where

tasks.task: Write shipping, returns and care copy in plain words

items.when: When shipping, returns and privacy pages need clean, plain versions
When a product needs a short care or how-to-use guide in numbered steps
Before publishing, to find gaps, clashes and unclear wording in the policies

tasks.task: Word a sale, price cut or deadline honestly

items.when: When a discount is planned, to choose percent or amount and the banner words
When you have the full and sale price, to compare ways to show the saving
Before the sale goes live, to check the discount against margin and the rules
Before the wording is final, to confirm the sale price, code and end date are live on the store today

tasks.task: Write launch or seasonal emails for new products

items.when: When a new range or season needs email copy by block from the product facts
Before sending, to compare subject lines from several angles
When the launch needs more than one email, to plan three different orders and draft each first email
When the email is drafted, to get cuts and a ship or fix score
When the three launch plans are drafted, so a fresh reviewer picks the one to write in full
Before any email is written, to confirm the new product is live, in stock and at the stated price

always.when: Before any work for a store with a live site, to capture its voice, facts and prices
When a batch is drafted, to fix off-brand words without touching the claims
Before delivery, to fix lines that read as machine written
Last step before upload, to catch slips with a log of every change
Before hand-over, so a fresh reader checks the copy against the brief as the shop owner would
Before copy goes live, to trace each price, size, material and policy line to the fact sheet or cut it

helpers.when: When copy must be loaded into the store, or themes, fields and feeds need set-up
When the Amazon job goes past the listing into keywords, ads and account health
When the Etsy job needs shop set-up, tags research and pricing as well as copy
When the catalogue needs keyword research or a technical search audit first
When order and launch emails need flows, timing and list rules built
When the gallery needs new images to answer shopper questions

gaps: No library item writes food copy from a label: tasting notes, allergen wording and storage lines rest on the kit alone
No library item makes and compares title options for each surface; title tools give one answer
No library item writes an Etsy listing from scratch; the scorer only improves one that exists
No library item checks environmental or origin claims against consumer rules
No library item compares near-identical products and names what sets each apart
No library item writes a size guide or care label copy
No library item writes transactional order and dispatch emails; the nearest ones plan flows and timing
No library item turns shopper questions into photo captions; the gallery workflow plans images, not words
No library item finds duplicate or supplier-pasted descriptions across a catalogue export
No English library item localises a listing's sizes, units and required labels for another country; the one that exists is written in Chinese
